prior_findings_rechecked.observation: The widened9m service wing beside28m vault reads as a substantial distinct planted volume, with charcoal sides, real front openings and closed end/inner connections.

Fresh images show two rows of four vault rooflights and four wing lights, the long shoulder light, and one-slope PV divided into three groups. Volumetric curb sides seat into the curved carrier; glazing caps close them, and interior wells visibly open through the roof.

The glazing is recessed behind the grounded arch with a four-metre porch, deck, bench seats, bounded lower living-wall flanks and a small attached entrance canopy. The complete door/threshold approach is visible and clear.
Two louvred ventilation shafts now match the source-pair schedule and remain grounded and capped.

holistic_assessment.observation: Planted asymmetric two-volume plan, barrel hall, deep timber arch/porch, discrete skylights, solar groups and vent pair retain the locked source architecture. Fine texture, planting morphology and ornament are simplified native geometry.

Rear and rear-side show closed wing and vault ends. Roof cover bounds the ribs. Rooflight curbs visibly reach the roof surface, cap rails and glass close the tops, and no glaring new roof holes or floating roof objects are apparent.

Glass and interior views expose physical glulam supports, ceiling openings, eight-lane basin, coping, floats, starting blocks, benches, tables and changing partitions with interior depth. Pedestrian view includes a clear doorway threshold and approach.

All eight whole-building views retain complete roof/footprint margins; close views resolve facade/entrance, glass, rooflight contacts and pool interior. Phone board is fresh and marked Browser NOT TESTED.
